sections.title: Entertainment Rights and IP Knowledge RAG
sections.description: For Universal Pictures, Warner Bros., Sony Pictures, Disney, and the entertainment IP management community.

blocks.heading: Rights chain intelligence RAG
paragraphs: RAG over entertainment rights databases, licensing agreements, clearance histories, and underlying rights documentation for studios' business affairs teams — enabling business affairs attorneys and executives to ask natural language questions like 'What distribution rights do we hold for this title in Japan post-2027?' and receive synthesized answers from complex rights documentation that may span dozens of agreements.

blocks.heading: Guild and talent agreement RAG
paragraphs: RAG over SAG-AFTRA, DGA, and WGA collective bargaining agreements, side letters, and interpretation guidance for studios' labor relations teams — enabling HR, production finance, and legal teams to query guild requirements without manual CBA search.

blocks.heading: Music licensing knowledge RAG
paragraphs: RAG for the music supervisors, licensing coordinators, and music publishers managing LA's enormous music licensing market — querying synchronization rights histories, publisher catalogs, and licensing rate precedents for film and television music licensing decisions.
All entertainment RAG: self-hosted Llama 3 or Mistral on corporate infrastructure — IP never leaves the studio network.

sections.title: Legal Knowledge RAG (BigLaw and Immigration)
sections.description: For O'Melveny & Myers, Gibson Dunn, Latham & Watkins, and LA's large legal community.

blocks.heading: Entertainment law research RAG
paragraphs: RAG over case law, statutory materials, and proprietary precedent databases for the entertainment law practices at LA's major law firms — enabling attorneys to query California labor law, copyright law, and entertainment contract precedent in natural language within a system that maintains attorney-client privilege and work product protection.

blocks.heading: Immigration law knowledge RAG
paragraphs: RAG over USCIS policy manuals, Administrative Appeals Office decisions, immigration court precedent, and Department of Labor wage determination databases for LA's world-leading immigration law community — one of the most comprehensive immigration law knowledge applications in the US.

blocks.heading: Multi-practice knowledge management
paragraphs: RAG for LA's large multi-practice law firms — knowledge management systems enabling attorneys to query prior deal terms, research memoranda, and firm precedent across all practice areas.

sections.title: Clinical Knowledge Management RAG
sections.description: For Cedars-Sinai Medical Center, UCLA Health, and Kaiser Permanente SoCal.

blocks.heading: Multilingual clinical knowledge RAG
paragraphs: HIPAA-compliant clinical guideline and protocol RAG for Cedars-Sinai's diverse patient-facing clinical workforce — with query capability in Spanish, Chinese, Korean, and Tagalog for the clinical staff serving LA's multilingual patient population.

blocks.heading: Oncology knowledge RAG
paragraphs: RAG for Cedars-Sinai's Smidt Heart Institute and cancer programs — querying clinical trial eligibility criteria, evidence-based oncology guidelines, and tumor board reference materials.

blocks.heading: Medi-Cal coverage knowledge RAG
paragraphs: RAG over California Medi-Cal coverage rules, California Children's Services (CCS) criteria, and LA County Department of Health Services policies for clinical and administrative staff navigating CA's complex public insurance landscape.

sections.title: Real Estate and Mortgage RAG
sections.description: For CBRE LA, JLL Los Angeles, and LA's large mortgage and title insurance community.

blocks.heading: California disclosure knowledge RAG
paragraphs: RAG over California's complex seller disclosure requirements (TDS, SPQ, natural hazard disclosures, AB 2584 wildfire disclosure) for real estate agents and brokers navigating the most disclosure-intensive real estate regulatory environment in the US.

blocks.heading: Mortgage product and guideline RAG
paragraphs: RAG for mortgage loan officers and underwriters querying Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, and jumbo investor guidelines for LA's active and complex mortgage market — where high-balance conforming loans, jumbo mortgages, and the specific condo project requirements for LA's large condo market all require specialized underwriting guidance.

sections.title: Los Angeles RAG technical context
sections.description: Key technical and compliance considerations for Los Angeles RAG deployments.

blocks.heading: Self-hosted as entertainment default
paragraphs: LA entertainment studios cannot transmit proprietary IP, unreleased content information, or talent contract details to external LLM APIs. ClickMasters deploys self-hosted Llama 3 70B for all entertainment RAG as the standard approach — no exceptions for studio clients.

blocks.heading: CCPA data governance for all consumer RAG
paragraphs: California consumer data processed through LA's RAG systems must comply with CCPA — ClickMasters designs all LA consumer RAG with CCPA baseline data governance.

blocks.heading: Multilingual retrieval for LA
paragraphs: LA's RAG applications routinely require multilingual retrieval capability — Spanish-language legal documents, Chinese-language healthcare records, and Korean-language immigration filings all appear in LA's RAG knowledge bases. ClickMasters uses multilingual embedding models (multilingual-e5-large or similar) for all LA RAG where multilingual documents are anticipated.
